newsitem.title: SYRIA: Iran's Velayati opens talks with Shara in Syria.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Velayati opens talks with Shara in Syria.

text.p: Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati opened talks with his Syrian counterpart Farouq al-Shara on Monday on the "latest regional developments and bilateral ties," officials said.
They said that Velayati was expected to meet President Hafez al-Assad during his visit to Syria to deliver a message from President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani.
In remarks to reporters on arrival Velayati condemned the policies of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and expressed support for "Syria's resistance and steadfastness".
Syria has strongly condemned Netanyahu's refusal to trade occupied Arab lands for peace and his removal of a freeze on Jewish settlements in the occupied West Bank.
The Syrian-Israeli talks, which opened in Madrid in 1991, are blocked over the Golan Heights, captured by Israel in 1967.
Syria, Iran's closest ally in the Middle East, has played a mediating role to settle disputes between Iran and its Gulf Arab neighbours.
